claim_verdicts.evidence: Round 2: §3 now uses the round-1 suggested_text verbatim; §4 and §6 say RabbitMQ delivers the headers the publisher set and does not create/touch traceparent. Publishers page: headers = "An arbitrary map of headers with string header names", set by publishers. Quorum Queues: "x-delivery-count" header "included with any redelivered message". DLX: "Dead-lettering a message modifies its headers". The new wording allows for both.

OutboxMessage.cs L24-29: `public string? TraceParent { get; init; } = MessageTracing.CurrentTraceParent();`. MessageTracing.cs L22-23: `Activity.Current is { IdFormat: ActivityIdFormat.W3C } current ? current.Id : null`. Migrations AddOutboxTraceParent/AddTraceParent add trace_parent `nullable: true`, so older rows are NULL. Read from the working tree: git show / tools/extract-code at stage-3 were not permitted in this session (Bash denied); the excerpts match the working tree character for character.

C# programming guide, Constructors: "The following actions take place in the following order: ... Field initializers run ... The instance constructor runs ... Object initializers run." An auto-property initializer initialises the backing field, so it runs at construction. Repo: no `TraceParent =` assignment on any OutboxMessage (grep), so no caller passes it.

DonHangDbContext.cs L131 `e.Property(m => m.TraceParent).HasColumnName("trace_parent")`; PaymentsDbContext.cs L56 same for OutboxMessage, L36 for Payment. Migrations 20261006004259_AddOutboxTraceParent (outbox_messages) and 20261006004242_AddTraceParent (payments, outbox_messages) add the column. Working tree, see claim 2.

Payment.cs L30 TraceParent; RefundRequestedConsumer.cs L114 sets it inside the StartConsume span (L55). RefundSender.cs (working tree) L20-21 BackgroundService; L56 `StartChildOf(refund.TraceParent, "refund attempt")`; L59-60 RecordResult's message added to OutboxMessages inside that span; L111 returns null on a retry (no row). PaymentEventsConsumer.cs L63: the Api also creates rows in a consumer span.

PostgreSQL 17, Transaction Isolation: "Read Committed is the default isolation level ... a SELECT query ... never sees either uncommitted data"; "SELECT FOR UPDATE ... will only find target rows that were committed as of the command start time." OutboxRelay.cs L16 `Tick = TimeSpan.FromSeconds(1)`, L21 PeriodicTimer, L76-82 `FOR UPDATE SKIP LOCKED`.

.NET docs: "The current activity automatically flows along all synchronous calls on a thread and follows async calls that are processed on different threads." OutboxRelay.cs (working tree) L19-35: ExecuteAsync loop driven by PeriodicTimer, called from no request, starts no Activity; the only span in RelayDueAsync is StartPublish (L57), per message. So no span is current in the loop, as §4 now says.

MessageTracing.cs L31 `StartChildOf(message.TraceParent, $"publish {message.RoutingKey}", ActivityKind.Producer)`; L53 `ActivityContext.TryParse(traceParent, null, isRemote: true, out var saved)`; L56 `Source.StartActivity(name, kind, parent)` with `Source = new(SourceName)` ("DonHang.Messaging").

Concepts doc: "Another common industry name for units of work in a distributed trace are 'Spans'. .NET adopted the term 'Activity'". ActivityKind API: Producer = "Output provided to external components.", Consumer = "Output received from an external component." Walkthrough uses SetTag to add tags. StartActivity parentContext: "The parent ActivityContext object to initialize the created activity object with." TracePropagationTests L91: null row has no parent.

OutboxRelay.cs L57-58: `using var activity = MessageTracing.StartPublish(message, publisher.Exchange); await publisher.PublishAsync(message, stoppingToken);` inside `foreach (var message in due)`. RabbitMqPublisher.cs L33-35: `var traceParent = MessageTracing.CurrentTraceParent() ?? message.TraceParent;` then `Headers = ... { [MessageTracing.TraceParentHeader] = traceParent }` with TraceParentHeader = "traceparent".

MessageTracing.cs L43 `StartChildOf(Read(properties), $"process {queue}", ActivityKind.Consumer)`, Read() L60-63 reads header "traceparent". Calls: DonHang.Notifications/OrderEventsConsumer.cs L71, DonHang.Payments/RefundRequestedConsumer.cs L55, DonHang.Api/Messaging/PaymentEventsConsumer.cs L63; these are the only three AsyncEventingBasicConsumer users in the repo. §5 now names the three services.
